description: Portfolio holdings of any US mutual fund or ETF from its latest SEC Form N-PORT filing: every position with name, CUSIP, ISIN, LEI, ticker, balance, units, value in USD, percent of net assets, asset and issuer category, country and fair-value level, plus fund totals (assets, liabilities, net assets) and the reporting period. Look up by ticker (IVV, VTI, ARKK) or SEC series id. Sort by weight, value or name; filter by asset category; up to 1,000 positions per call. Price: $0.01 USDC per call (x402).

asset_category.description: Filter by N-PORT asset category, e.g. EC (equity), DBT (debt), STIV (short-term), DE (derivative)

series.description: SEC series id such as S000004310 (alternative to ticker)

ticker.description: Fund or ETF ticker, e.g. IVV, VTI, ARKK

name: sec_fund_holdings
